sections.promotionCombinable: Can be combined with other promotions

latePolicy.title: Late arrival policy
latePolicy.text: Please arrive on time for your workshop. If you arrive more than 30 minutes late, your booking may be released and your reserved spot may be offered to walk-in guests. If there are still available spots when you arrive, you may still be able to join.

booking.title: Book a workshop
booking.subtitle: Reserve your spot at {shop}.
booking.noAvailability: No upcoming sessions are available for this workshop.
booking.cutoffNote: Online booking closes {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} before a session starts.
booking.slotGone: That session can no longer be booked: online booking closes {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} before it starts. Please choose another time.
booking.slotFull: The last seats of that session were just taken. Please choose another time.
booking.noneSelectable: Every session of this workshop is full or has already passed.
booking.otpIntro: We sent a verification code to {email}. Enter it to finish your booking.
booking.otpHint: The code has {length} digits. Check your spam folder if you cannot find the email.
booking.otpDemo: Demo: nothing is emailed yet, use {code}.
booking.otpWrong: That code is not correct. {left, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left.
booking.otpLocked: Too many wrong codes. Go back and confirm your booking again to get a new code.
booking.spotsLeft: {count, plural, one {# spot left} other {# spots left}}
booking.guestsHint: Up to {max} guests for this session.
booking.phoneHint: Include the country code, for example +84.
booking.totalNote: This total is for display only; the studio confirms the final price.
booking.consent: I agree to the booking terms, including the late arrival policy above.
booking.submitError: We could not complete your booking. Please try again.
booking.previewDone: Preview: your guests would now see their booking confirmation. No booking was made.
booking.accuracyNotice: Please note: when you book, choose the correct workshop and enter the correct number of guests. We are not responsible if the booking details are wrong or the number of guests does not match.
booking.promotionsHint: Choose the promotions you want to use (optional). Some promotions cannot be combined with others: choosing one of them replaces the rest.
booking.promotionDroppedByAlone: “{pick}” can only be used on its own, so these promotions were unchecked: {names}.
booking.promotionDroppedAlone: “{names}” cannot be combined with other promotions, so it was unchecked when you chose “{pick}”.
booking.promotionAloneActive: “{pick}” is used on its own and cannot be combined with other promotions. Choose another promotion to switch.

confirmation.title: Booking received
confirmation.intro: Thank you! Your spot at {shop} is reserved.
confirmation.changeOrCancel: To change or cancel, please contact the studio.
confirmation.notFoundText: We could not find a booking with these details. Check the link in your confirmation email.
confirmation.pendingText: We sent an email to {email} with the details and a link. Open the link to confirm your booking; until then it is not confirmed.
confirmation.demoLink: open the link of the email
confirmation.demoEmail: view the email that was sent
confirmation.cancelText: The seats go back to the studio and we email you a confirmation. You cannot undo this.
confirmation.cancelFailed: The booking could not be cancelled. It may have started already; please contact the studio.
confirmation.cancelledByGuest: You cancelled this booking. We sent you an email to confirm it.
confirmation.cancelledByShop: The studio cancelled this booking. Please contact the studio if you have questions.
confirmation.changeOnly: To change the booking, please contact the studio.

report.title: Report this site
report.intro: Tell us what is wrong with this site. Our team will review your report.
report.emailHint: Only used if we need to follow up with you.
report.thanksText: Our team will review it shortly.

errors.descriptionShort: Please describe the problem (at least 10 characters).
errors.rateLimited: You have sent several reports recently. Please try again later.
errors.network: We could not send your report. Check your connection and try again.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

report.previewNote: Preview: reports are not sent from the builder.

confirmLink.confirmedText: Thank you! Your booking is now confirmed. See you at the studio.
confirmLink.alreadyText: This booking was already confirmed. Nothing else to do.
confirmLink.cancelledText: This booking was cancelled, so it cannot be confirmed. Please contact the studio.
confirmLink.invalidText: We could not find a booking for this link. Check the link in your email, or contact the studio.

favorites.consentRequired: Please tick the box to create your account.
favorites.categoriesHint: We will use them to suggest workshops later. Choose exactly 3.
favorites.loginInvalid: The email or the password is wrong.
favorites.loginDeactivated: This account is deactivated. Contact the support of the platform.
favorites.loginTooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
favorites.loginFailed: Could not log in. Please try again.
